key_insight: BrReMark adds explicit region marking and re-checking to brain MRI diagnosis, helping the model ground its conclusions in image evidence instead of single-pass guesses.
clinical_relevance: This could make brain MRI AI outputs more auditable and potentially reduce false alarms or hallucinated findings, including on out-of-distribution scans.
method: Hypothesize possible abnormalities, then mark the suspected ROI with bounding boxes.
Re-examine the marked region to verify the final diagnosis.
Train with structured reasoning supervision plus reinforcement learning using localization and reasoning rewards, with synthetic pathology augmentation for better OOD robustness.
evidence_signal: On the internal benchmark, BrReMark raised mAP50 from 0.74% to 37.54% and reached 21.57% Clinical F1 and 45.26% diagnostic accuracy; on NOVA it cut false positives by 45.7% versus the state of the art.
watch_item: The gains come from a specialized MRI framework and reported benchmark settings, so real-world reliability, workflow fit, and performance across broader scanners and institutions still need validation.
paper_title: Enhancing Brain MRI Anomaly Detection and Reasoning with ROI Rethink and Synthetic Data
